name: AWS Cost and Usage Reports
overview: AWS Cost and Usage Reports (CUR) tạo detailed billing/usage data files, thường gửi tới S3 để truy vấn/phân tích.
examSignals: Granular itemized billing and usage dataset for custom analysis: CUR
Quick interactive spend visualization: Cost Explorer

compareWith.diff: CUR cung cấp detailed export data để tự phân tích; Cost Explorer cung cấp built-in interactive cost views.
